client.business_model: Multi-site women's health provider operating OB-GYN clinics and ancillary telehealth services across multiple states
client.sponsor_pe_firm: BlueMountain Capital Management (Assured Guaranty) and Deerfield Management Company
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 in Arlington, Virginia by Sean Glass, Advantia Health has grown through acquisitions such as Heartland Women’s Healthcare (2019) and the Pacify telehealth platform, and in 2020 secured a $45 million growth investment from BlueMountain Capital to accelerate expansion.

revenue.notes: Publicly available estimates vary widely: Zippia $13 M, Growjo $22.4 M, Buzzfile $29.1 M, CanvasBusinessModel $89 M (2024). No official filings found. Selected Buzzfile figure as midpoint; wide range indicates low confidence.

locations.source: Company locations page (https://www.advantiahealth.com/locations/) and PR about Heartland acquisition (PR Newswire, Feb 2019)
locations.notes: Heartland acquisition added 25 clinics; Mid-Atlantic listings show 20+ additional sites. Exact current total not enumerated; estimated ~50 clinics.

employees.source: LeadIQ company profile (Dec 2025) and Indeed company page
employees.notes: LeadIQ lists ~501 employees; Indeed and SignalHire list 500-1,000; Zippia cites 750; Buzzfile 259. Majority of sources cluster around 500+, therefore using 501 with medium confidence.
